gugugu.processor.mention.description: §7Allows using §8@{§bPlayerName§8}§7 or §8@all§7 to notify specific players
gugugu.processor.link.description: §7When a valid §9HTTP link§7 appears in a player's message, it is automatically converted to a clickable link
gugugu.processor.link.example1: §7This message will highlight §9"https://www.baidu.com"§7 in blue and make it clickable
gugugu.processor.component.description: §7(This component cannot be removed) Merges §6mention§7, §9link§7 and other special messages into rich text.
gugugu.processor.mention_notify.descript: §7An additional component for §6mention§7 that implements special effects for notified players (§bsound§7, §dscreen display§7, etc.)
gugugu.processor.mention_notify.example1: §7After mention processing, this message will trigger §bsound§7 and §dscreen notification§7 for all players except the sender
gugugu.processor.teleport.description: §7If a player only enters a valid §bplayer name§7 in the chat, it will be given the ability to teleport to that player when clicked
gugugu.processor.teleport.example1: §7This message will specially display §b"Steven"§7 and allow teleporting to that player when clicked
gugugu.processor.hand_item.description:
§7Allows displaying item information from specific player slots in chat, can appear multiple times

§6[i]§7 - Main hand §6[io]§7 - Off hand
